_comment: Every role maps to a REAL account that must resolve to a SID on the
generating host. These are deliberately domain accounts, not well-known
SIDs: an ACE for CORP\StorageAdmins cannot be collapsed into a POSIX
mode bit or an NFSv4 OWNER@/GROUP@/EVERYONE@ special principal, so a
repair tool has to carry the real identity through ID-mapping.
Roles are referenced by name from the scenario library.
'control' is an OPTIONAL extra safety-ACE grantee. It is not what keeps
you out of a lockout: the generator always grants a full-control ACE to
the account running it, because UAC's filtered token makes an admin-group
ACE inert in a non-elevated process.
